llm_response.Content: When a new version is indexed, the old version is retained based on its current relevance and ingestion depth, with no explicit global or storage-based eviction. Historical versions remain available in the system as part of the versioned-source retention mechanism, ensuring that the current-version queries can access the most relevant data without dominating the ordinary current-version queries.
